description: From the fz-kdt.152 refutation (2026-09-02): exact_direct_callable_layout's agreement is full CallableDescr equality and its REFUSING half (disagreement -> fallback) is correct by construction -- but has zero test and zero corpus witness: the refuter loosened agreement to function-identity-only and ALL 875 fixtures stayed byte-identical in canon and behavior. A future 'simplification' could gut the refusal unnoticed. The natural red witness is fz-kdt.127's same-fn-id/different-captures shape, WHICH DOES NOT COMPILE TODAY -- so this ticket is blocked-in-practice by 127 (or by any compiling shape that mints one function at two capture layouts). When 127's shape compiles: write the refusal test red-first against the loosened check. Until then this records the invariant's unguarded status.

comments.text: CLOSED by fz-kdt.127.1/.2 (2026-09-02): the refusing half now has a reachable witness. lower_closure_capture reads the repr from the constructions that minted the grounded layout; loosening constructions_minting to function-identity-only turns compiler2_a_capture_unpack_reads_the_constructions_that_minted_its_layout RED and makes the native door refuse same_lambda_two_capture_types_dynamic.fz (proven red-first by the 127.1 build, RED-157 marker, and re-homed onto the dynamic twin in 127.2 where the unpack actually occurs). title: The layout-agreement check's refusing half has zero coverage: loosening it to function-identity-only ships green through every gate
